mission: Cut agent-to-mergeable wall-clock: remove the tstyche lane, measure where quality time goes (fleet + hosted CI), and census TS instantiation/memory cost with a staged remediation plan.

completionGate.statement: Not achieved until this goal's work ships as a PR driven to mergeable via /yeet (bun run beep yeet: repair -> verify -> publish --pr -> monitor).

phases.name: Decisions
phases.exit: Grill-with-docs session over the three reports locks the performance decisions; tstyche delete-vs-port is gating.

phases.name: Tstyche removal
phases.exit: Removal per reviewed inventory + grill decisions; tsconfig-sync --check returns 0; residue gate clean.

phases.name: Ship
phases.exit: One PR: packet + reports + decisions + removal, via yeet, citing quality-speedup.

stopConditions: A *.tst.ts unique type assertion lacks user sign-off before deletion.
Tstyche removal requires edits outside the inventoried surfaces.
A workstream turns out to be owned by an active packet.
A measurement instrument cannot be verified.
Any change would touch public API, schemas, migrations, auth, infra, security behavior, dependencies, lockfiles, or generated files beyond what Workstream A explicitly requires.
